brief.task: Answer the six questions below from the data at the end of this brief. It is a reading check, not research.
brief.context: Only the data below (孫子's decision rules 1-5, as XML). Do not use tools, do not open files, do not write files.

questions.q: Which item number has the kind "algorithm"?
How many of the five items are labelled entirely `quoted`, with no `attributed` part?
Which chapter is cited as the source of item 3? Give its Chinese name.
Which item number cites Roger T. Ames?
In item 1, how many "matters" and how many "questions" are the two sides compared on?
In item 3, which target is ranked last (worst)?

brief.template: Reply with only this, in English, filling the angle brackets: --- node: q1 attempt: 1 engine: <your engine> status: ok --- <the answer in one sentence> | q | answer | item | |---|---|---| | 1 | <answer> | <item number> |
brief.standard: Each answer is checked against the data; an answer not in the data is wrong. Six table rows, English only (Chinese is allowed only when quoting a name from the data). Nothing before the first `---` or after the table.
brief.limits: No tools, no files. Reply in English.
